android.desc: Tired of searching for the perfect words? Meet AInput, the AI writing assistant that brought Apple style writing tools to Android in September 2024, before Apple Intelligence reached the iPhone. Tap one button inside any chat to get instant replies, clean rewrites, voice to message, or a quick answer from Ask AI. From a flirty text to a witty comeback to a polished work email, AInput helps you say it right without leaving the app you are in. Featured in Best Android Apps of 2024 by AndroidAuthority.com and TechWiser (YouTube). Features You'll Love AI Reply ◦ Reply suggestions for social and dating apps in 10+ tones, based on the real conversation on your screen. AI Rewrite ◦ Turn a rough or messy draft into a polished message in almost any app, in 10+ tones. Voice ◦ Too busy to type? Just talk, and AInput turns your voice into the right words. Just say the gist ◦ Give a quick instruction like "say yes, suggest Friday, keep it sweet" and AInput writes the full reply using the chat. It is not dictation, it understands. Ask AI ◦ Need a hand? Ask things like: - What is a clever way to keep this chat going? - Can you guess what they will say next? - Help me write a caption for this photo. You get personalized answers based on what you ask. Choose How Your AI Runs Built-in ◦ Works right away, no account or setup. On-device ◦ On supported phones, run AInput privately so your chats never leave your device. Custom AI Provider ◦ Prefer your own AI Provider? Sign in and use it inside every app. Great for Work and Personal Chats Write clear emails, fix grammar, and proofread in seconds, or add personality to a casual text. AInput sounds right whether you are being professional or playful. Better Than an AI Keyboard Unlike generic AI keyboards, AInput works right inside your favorite apps, social, messaging, or email. Smart replies and rewrites, with no keyboard switching. Make It Yours Enabled apps ◦ Pick which apps AInput works in. Default tone ◦ Set your go to tone for Reply and Rewrite. Custom prompts ◦ Save and reuse your favorite Ask AI prompts. Privacy First AI Reply uses only the messages visible on screen, AI Rewrite uses only your draft, and Voice uses only your audio, each just to create your message. Everything

show_hn.title: Show HN: AI that gives you reply suggestions on all social media chats [app]

quotes.text:
Hey HN!

I built this Android app that gives you reply suggestions and message rewrite suggestions in any chat on Instagram, FB Messenger, and WhatsApp right from the chat bar. It can do quick replies, witty comebacks, and even flirty lines! It has 10 different writing styles and works on both direct and group chats. Currently supports 50+ languages.

It works by reading the content on the screen via the accessibility service. It uses the keyboard area to display the messages and works with all keyboards.

Currently gauging interest to find the right target audience and what people would primarily use this for, and seeking feedback to decide on adding support for more apps :)

You can try it from the post link. It's free to try! Happy to answer any questions :)

You can see it in action here: https://x.com/kkrcodes/status/1827372004711784763

Background context if anyone cares:
I recently got fired from my job, and it was a tough time. But I decided to channel my energy into something positive, and this app is the result.
